authority: Write only named source, tooling, starter and evidence paths. Use disposable /private/tmp build fixtures and already verified exact dependencies. No edits to frozen contract/package/lock/notices/schema, frontend application source/assets, shared canonical helpers, Task, memory, active root installation, Template or Git.
criteria: Asset validation accepts only the exact closed manifest shape, safe no-follow single-link bounded files, correct paths/MIME/hashes/entry/import closure, excluding metadata and repository paths from the runtime map.

Build tools compute exact source_digest and noncircular build_id, inject build/schema identity, use pinned existing Node/npm/Vite/TypeScript and stage/validate complete output before manifest-last publication; only prior reviewed manifest-owned assets may be removed.

Neutral starter is exact strict schema version1, project_id null and empty mappings; active specialization is separate. No depot identity, browser authority, hooks or runtime dependencies are introduced.

Actual disposable minimal Vite production build and publisher tests prove deterministic identities, valid closed package, tamper/traversal/symlink/hardlink/unknown/missing/over-budget rejection and preservation outside the owned output inventory. This is tooling evidence, not final product/browser/HTTP acceptance.
deliverable: Frozen package tooling and neutral starter with exact no-follow manifest/identity/import-closure and actual disposable production build/publisher tests. Final application assets and HTTP tests are explicitly reserved for later consumer integration.
objective: Implement the frozen pure asset-manifest validator, explicit build/publisher tooling and neutral presentation starter from TASK-010. This independent tooling slice precedes HTTP integration and final frontend production generation; it does not by itself complete TASK-010.
rationale: The accepted extra-complex CONTRACTS synthesis fixes manifest, identity, build, configuration, offline and file-safety architecture. One worker implements this pure bounded tooling slice; service and real frontend integration remain explicit later criteria, with no claim that fixtures prove HTTP or production behavior.

slots.perspective: Pure offline manifest and reproducible publisher implementation

stop: All tooling criteria pass current meaningful tests; any accepted-contract defect is returned to manager without silent architecture or dependency change.
